## Verified Portfolio Projects

### 1. SPARCS Healthcare & Business Intelligence System
- Role: Data Engineering & Business Intelligence (personal project)
- Results: 16.3M+ inpatient discharge records across 7 years; PostgreSQL star schema with 8 dimensions and 1 fact table; 11 analytics views; 6 materialized views; 8-page Power BI dashboard
- Tech Stack: PostgreSQL, Power BI, ETL, Star Schema, SQL Analytics, Materialized Views, PL/pgSQL
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/sparcs-healthcare-bi-platform
- Documentation: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/sparcs-healthcare-bi-platform/tree/main/DOCS

### 2. Medical Inventory Forecasting & Decision Support System
- Role: Machine Learning & Healthcare Analytics (personal project)
- Results: 14 regression models and ensembles benchmarked; tuned Gradient Boosting selected (R² 0.7978 on test, RMSE 9.692); SHAP explainability; K-Means inventory segmentation; deployed Streamlit app
- Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-Learn, SHAP, Streamlit, XGBoost, K-Means, Gradient Boosting
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/Medical-Inventory-Forecasting-Decision-Support-System
- Live Demo: https://hemanthsai-medical-inventory-decision-support.streamlit.app/

### 3. Multimodal Cold-Start Movie Recommender
- Role: Recommendation Systems & Multimodal AI (personal project)
- Results: 19,232 multimodal movies (MovieLens 20M); 2,107 test movies unseen in training; cold-start RMSE 0.8843, about 21% lower than a global-mean baseline on the same subset
- Tech Stack: Python, TensorFlow, CLIP (poster embeddings), VGGish (audio embeddings), Neural Collaborative Filtering, MovieLens
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/Multimodal-Cold-Start-Movie-Recommender
- Live Demo: https://hemanth-cold-start-user-based-movie-recommendation.streamlit.app/

### 4. Data Center Resource Analytics
- Role: Data Analytics & Predictive Modeling (personal project)
- Results: 2.75M+ server telemetry records; physics-based heat, cooling-water and evaporative-water modeling; Linear Regression with leakage-prone features removed (held-out R² 0.9798, RMSE 0.013)
- Tech Stack: Python, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, Plotly
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/Data-Center-Resource-Analytics

### 5. NIDHI — AI Investor Super App
- Role: Full Stack & AI (personal project)
- Results: multi-asset portfolio tracker (stocks, mutual funds, REITs, InvITs, bonds); portfolio health, diversification and liquidity scores; Gemini assistant grounded in user holdings; Firebase authentication with email verification
- Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Firebase Auth, Gemini API
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/NIDHI
- Live Demo: https://nidhiapp.vercel.app

### 6. Human Decision Intelligence
- Role: Statistical Analysis & Explainable AI (personal project)
- Results: 105,000 held-out decisions on the CPC18 dataset; 70.95% test accuracy; ROC-AUC 0.7906 for the final model; GLM, GAM, Random Forest and XGBoost compared; SHAP and LIME explanations
- Tech Stack: R, Shiny, Statistical Modeling, PCA, XGBoost, SHAP, LIME, Behavioral Clustering
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/Human-Decision-Intelligence

### 14. Air Canvas — Touchless Drawing with Computer Vision

- Tech Stack: Python, OpenCV, MediaPipe, pytest
- Repository: https://github.com/Hemanthsai456/air-canvas
